description: Share a single task with a guest at a chosen permission level. Returns the updated guest. Enterprise plan only.

custom_task_ids.description: Set true when `task_id` is a custom task ID instead of a native ClickUp ID. Requires team_id.

guest_id.description: ID of the guest (the guest user's numeric id).

permission_level.description: Permission level to grant: 'read' (view only), 'comment', 'edit', or 'create'.

task_id.description: ID of the task to share.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: add_guest_to_task
